# Native SOP fixed baseline corpus

`capture.mjs` is a self-authored driver importing the actual TS SopStateStore and fixed approval authority; it contains no copied baseline implementation. It takes an explicit baseline root and a new exclusive output directory. The source SHA, Node/ICU versions and fixed clock are in oracle.json. The fixed Date clock was installed before the first capture, not inferred from Rust. Wait identifiers are explicit fixture input; no random identifiers are erased from results.

Baseline: cc7c4e653b15c8b2cec7bcf2d15d41d69396ae85. Node v22.22.0 / ICU78.2. oracle.json SHA256: 244e51fed28afd939c8e5f81e166da47c8c3e1d3fb11fe5210ab8dcebbcb163c.

The original capture ran on mbp2 under sandbox-exec with `(version 1) (allow default) (deny network*)`, isolated HOME/PILOT_HOME/TMPDIR, the fixed baseline tsx loader, and a throwing global fetch. Only injected authority responses are used. Exit0, 15 sequences /35 operations plus10 authentication cells, forbidden fetch0, empty stderr. Raw capture and profile are retained outside Git at /Users/da/ws/pdrs-worker-wt/control-cli-20261108/_tmp/native-sop-sol-20261109-01; the small oracle/log/profile copies are in the main repository _tmp/20261108-cli-completion/native-sop-sol/oracle. The tsx compiler cache is not an asset and was not copied into the repository.

Reproduce with the pinned Node and `--import BASELINE/node_modules/tsx/dist/loader.mjs capture.mjs BASELINE NEW_OUTPUT`, the same sandbox profile and isolated environment. Do not point it at a real installation or HOME. Default warning output is retained; NODE_NO_WARNINGS is not enabled. Production state resource tests and disk replay are Unix-specific; only mbp2/Darwin execution can be claimed after root validation. This candidate has only passed standalone rustfmt; Rust compilation/tests are pending root's mbp2 run.

State comparison includes exact JSON serialization of each result/error and every persisted record after each step. Authority tests compare the existing ApprovalBridge port's actual public status/code/subject contract and request route; the upstream Error.name/message are retained in the oracle but are not invented as fields in ApprovalFailure. HTTP response-body limits, atomic publish sync, non-regular/symlink refusal, helper output/deadline limits and non-Unix refusal are native safety boundaries to be registered separately. This component does not yet enable SOP execution: runtime client, real registry catalog/admission adapter, control callback and host decorator remain to be wired before removing the native SOP startup guard.
